cases.explain: «молочные реки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

cases.explain: «городским воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

cases.explain: «кричащего бедняка» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
